items.title: Cancel appointment (if unable to attend) at least two working days in advance
items.quote: Wenn Sie verhindert sind, sagen Sie bitte mindestens zwei Werktage vorher ab, damit wir den Termin anderweitig vergeben können.
items.computation: The appointment is Monday, 14.12.2026. The practice requires cancellation at least two 'Werktage' (Mon–Sat, excluding Sundays and public holidays) before the appointment. Counting back from the appointment: Sunday 13.12.2026 is not a Werktag (skipped); Saturday 12.12.2026 is the 1st Werktag before; Friday 11.12.2026 is the 2nd Werktag before. Hence the cancellation must reach the practice by Friday, 11.12.2026, at the latest. This is a private contractual notice period, not a statutory deadline, so it does not shift for weekends/holidays beyond the Werktage counting already applied.
